identified_limitations_and_warnings.description: External adapter documents (EXT_B2B, EXT_BN, EXT_INV) share identical static pixel templates across splits. Also synthetic triplet INDIC_0039/62 (train) vs INDIC_0061 (val) share exact pixel render.
identified_limitations_and_warnings.downstream_impact: Models evaluated on validation/test may achieve inflated accuracy due to template memorization rather than generalized OCR recognition.

identified_limitations_and_warnings.description: Baseline Phase 0 split separated near-duplicate pairs INDIC_0110 (test) vs INDIC_0111 (train) and INDIC_0160 (test) vs INDIC_0161 (train) (pHash Hamming distance <= 4).
identified_limitations_and_warnings.downstream_impact: Mild visual similarity leakage between train and test splits.

identified_limitations_and_warnings.description: 24 static field text strings from external adapter documents appear across all three splits.
identified_limitations_and_warnings.downstream_impact: Downstream language model decoders may overfit to exact invoice field strings.

suitability_for_baseline_ocr.condition: Suitable for baseline OCR model development, ablation studies, and pipeline benchmarking provided that evaluation reports document the template memorization caveat.
recommendations: Exclude external adapter templates from test-split zero-shot evaluation.
Incorporate unique invoice number generation in future synthetic iterations.
Consolidate near-duplicate pairs into the same partition before production deployment.
